verdict.rationale: Evidence shows no clear zero-to-first-API-call quickstart: the developer docs are gated behind an SSO wall (llama-supp-docs-gated), model weight downloads require submitting a request and waiting for a signed email URL (llama-gh-5), and there is no OpenAPI/llms.txt discoverable (llama-probe-1, llama-probe-2). The available CLI (llama-model download/list/verify-download) is a package-management tool, not a runnable 'first API call' example in a specific language.
